notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please go to an emergency department now, or call 911 if you feel faint, drowsy, confused or short of breath, or have no one to drive you — do not drive yourself. Very high sugar with repeated vomiting and being unable to keep fluids down can be a dangerous diabetic emergency needing blood tests and IV treatment. I recommend Counsel follow up in this thread afterwards.
